title: FaithfulCTI: Answer Accuracy and Rationale Validity Benchmark for CTI and Vulnerability Analysis
description: Replication package for FaithfulCTI, a benchmark that scores answer accuracy and the validity of the written rationale separately over 200 CTI/vulnerability items across four tasks (knowledge MCQ, CVE-to-CWE mapping, CVSS v3.1 severity estimation, and MITRE ATT&CK technique extraction). Includes the audited benchmark (testset v4f), model responses (main, clean-twin, voting, and reproducibility runs), expert labels and a four-tier rubric with English versions, the inter-annotator agreement package, scoring and reanalysis scripts, and result figures.
